criteria.notes: Real script with a real exit code: node scripts/build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check. Verified in WP04 T023/T024.

criteria.description: Every primitive is demonstrated over real <dl>/<details>/<table>/<a> markup in its stories -- verified by grepping the authored .html for the native tag, not by reading story titles. .sk-empty-state has no single required native tag by design (FR-005; a plain block container).
criteria.evidence: grep -rc counts (mission-wide, WP04 T025): facts <dl> 5/5 files; disclosure <details> 4/4 files (nested has 2); data-table <table> 3/3 files; skip-link <a > 1/1 file (3 anchors). empty-state has no single required tag by design (FR-005) -- noted, not silently skipped.
criteria.notes: Verified per-primitive in WP01/WP02/WP03, and mission-wide (all five, with per-tag match counts) in WP04 T025. Recorded grep output, not a committed CI script.

criteria.description: The narrow-width table keeps its headers and is keyboard-reachable: at a narrow viewport the scroll container (.sk-data-table__scroller) is focusable (tabindex="0"), has an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby), and <th scope> association is intact.
criteria.evidence: Re-stated at head (pre-merge gate pass 2 found the prior evidence stale on both counts -- wrong aria-label text, and claiming deferral after the proof had already arrived). sk-data-table-narrow-scrollable.html's .sk-data-table__scroller carries role="region" aria-label="Recent builds, narrow view" tabindex="0" (distinct from <caption>Recent builds</caption>, per the duplicate-name defect this exemplar's own comment calls out) and a baked-in max-width: 320px so it genuinely overflows at any viewport, not only inside its own story. run-axe-storybook.js's full pass (zero violations across every story, this mission's included) is the Storybook/axe accessibility-tree confirmation -- see SC-007's evidence for the exact run. Every <th scope="col"> is unchanged from the Default exemplar's markup.
criteria.notes: Devtools/accessibility-tree inspection plus the full axe pass -- see WP03 T018 and SC-007. Not an automated test; packages/styles has no test target.

criteria.description: packages/styles/src/index.ts exports every new primitive, verified by importing the package entry point and asserting each generated export name resolves. ALSO: packages/styles/package.json gains a ./<name>/* subpath export for each of the five new directories -- scripts/check-release-graph.mjs's checkSubpathCoverage is [ENFORCED] at ci-quality.yml:533 and fails one row per directory with no subpath export.
criteria.evidence: Pre-merge gate pass 1 correctly found the earlier SC-004 evidence measured the escaped source literal (never resolved the module) and one recorded value was stale. Re-verified by REAL import: esbuild.build({entryPoints:['packages/styles/src/index.ts'], bundle:true, format:'esm'}) then `import()` of the bundled output. Result: 77 total exported names, 0 collisions (Object.keys count matches Set size), all five new directories present and non-empty -- facts: 5 exports (SkFactsCompactHTML, SkFactsEmptyValueHTML, SkFactsHTML, SkFactsLongValueHTML, SkFactsTwoColHTML), disclosure: 4 (SkDisclosureClosedHTML, SkDisclosureLongBodyHTML, SkDisclosureNestedHTML, SkDisclosureOpenHTML), data-table: 3 (SkDataTableDefaultHTML, SkDataTableNarrowScrollableHTML, SkDataTableStickyHeaderHTML), empty-state: 2 (SkEmptyStateWithActionHTML, SkEmptyStateWithoutActionHTML), skip-link: 1 (SkSkipLinkUnfocusedHTML) -- 15 new names total, all typeof 'string' with length > 0. The bundle-and-import approach runs in milliseconds and needs no nx build. package.json subpath coverage half verified separately via check-release-graph.mjs (below).
criteria.notes: Two parts: (1) an import-and-resolve check for the five new export names, committed as a real test or recorded verbatim in the PR body (packages/styles/project.json has no test target -- see WP04 T021); (2) node scripts/check-release-graph.mjs, a real script with a real exit code, for the package.json subpath coverage half. This second half was entirely absent from the mission's original plan. Superseded the earlier throwaway-script evidence with a real resolved import per pre-merge gate pass 1's finding.

criteria.description: The forced-colors baseline is committed and demonstrated: with forced colors emulated, the skip link on focus, the disclosure marker, and the data-table's zebra/hover row distinction all remain perceivable. (Table borders was the issue's original -- and wrong -- guess for the third location; measured, a plain border already survives forced-colors mode with zero author rule, while background-based zebra/hover flattens to Canvas.)
criteria.evidence: Playwright page.emulateMedia({forcedColors:'active'}) against both colorScheme dark and light: disclosure marker color rgb(255,255,0) dark / rgb(0,0,159) light (both clearly visible, non-invisible); disclosure focus ring boxShadow:'none' (confirms box-shadow strips under forced-colors, motivating the outline-based fix) with outline 2px solid present in both schemes; data-table row2 (even) border-left 3px CanvasText-mapped both schemes, row2 hovered border-left 3px Highlight-mapped both schemes, row1 (odd) border-left 0px (baseline td border-bottom 1px CanvasText-mapped confirms borders already survive unaided). Skip-link focus outline under forced-colors confirmed present (3px solid, Highlight-mapped) in an earlier full run; a clean re-run of the skip-link's specific reveal-on-focus check under forced-colors emulation was blocked by intermittent host memory-pressure crashes in Chromium after repeated attempts -- the identical reveal mechanism (clip-path + :focus-visible) was independently confirmed reliable (5/5 and 2/2 clean runs) under normal (non-forced-colors) rendering, which forced-colors does not alter the layout/focus semantics of, only paint colors.
criteria.notes: Visual/devtools forced-colors emulation (Windows High Contrast, or Chromium devtools' 'Emulate CSS media feature forced-colors'), documented per story per WP02/WP03. Not an automated test.

Branch rebased onto origin/train/elements-first@0a9a28c (was dcf7af2), cache-free regenerate + full local gate suite re-run afterward: build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check clean, stylelint clean, htmlhint clean, quality:lint clean (8 projects), nx build tokens+styles+elements+react clean (--skip-nx-cache), check-release-graph.mjs clean, check-story-theme-wrapper.mjs + --selftest clean, check-gate-wiring.mjs clean, Storybook build clean (--skip-nx-cache), run-axe-storybook.js zero violations across 181 stories, npm test 244/244 passed (25 files) -- none of those tests exercise this mission's primitives (packages/styles has no test target), confirming nothing pre-existing broke. npx commitlint --from origin/train/elements-first --to HEAD --verbose: 0 errors across every commit on this branch (1 non-blocking footer-leading-blank warning on one commit). Pre-merge gate pass 1 folded (debugger request-changes, 2 HIGH; architect/reviewer approve-with-findings; reducer no-blocker): sticky-header border-collapse fix, disclosure marker accessible-name fix, hover-consistency fix, sticky z-index fix, stylelint.config.mjs ignoreValues + longhand-color fix, three ForcedColorsBaseline decoy stories deleted, demo scaffolding trimmed from three exemplars, docs/design-system/using-components.md given five new sections, expected-stories.json given 21 new entries (total 59->80). Re-ran the full gate suite after folding: stylelint clean, htmlhint clean (39 files), quality:lint clean (cache-free, 8 projects), build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check clean, nx build (cache-free) clean, check-release-graph.mjs clean, check-story-theme-wrapper.mjs + --selftest clean, check-gate-wiring.mjs clean, Storybook build clean, run-axe-storybook.js: zero violations across 178 stories (one real scrollable-region-focusable violation was found and fixed mid-pass on the StickyHeader story, not a pre-existing pass).
criteria.notes: The full local gate suite in plan.md's 'Local gate commands' section, run and recorded in WP04 T024.
